name: manual_58ec2d
claim: Cline fan-out routes must verify provider auth, not only model slugs; if a ClinePass model is routed through another provider, stop and repair auth/config instead of silently switching models.

decisions.notes: A DeepSeek Flash ClinePass smoke run accepted the CLI command shape but failed because the active provider rejected the ClinePass model slug. The durable fix is a provider-auth gate plus local help verification, with prompts and logs scrubbed of private values.
